body.content: Counterfactual: what if we use 5 rows instead of 4? With 5 rows and ~2-3 points per row, the row spacing is 1/4 = 0.25. Intra-row minimum for 3 points in a row of width 1 is ~0.5*(1)*(0.25) = 0.125 if staggered, but with only 2-3 points per row, intra-row triangles may not exist (need 3 in a row). Inter-row minimum with 0.25 spacing and 0.5 stagger: ~0.5*0.5*0.25 = 0.0625. This suggests 5 rows could be better! The configuration 3-3-3-2-2 = 13 points across 5 rows might achieve ~0.04+.
body.possible_next_move: Construct a 5-row configuration with 3-3-3-2-2 points and compute the exact minimum triangle area.
body.why_keep_this: This is a promising alternative that the main candidates haven't explored. 5 rows with fewer points per row might avoid the intra-row minimum bottleneck.
